name: autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit
description: Total vacuum cost budget available to all autovacuum workers before they pause; shared proportionally among concurrent workers.
symptoms: Delayed cleanup causing transaction ID wraparound risk
High CPU or IO wait during maintenance windows
tuning_tips: Increase to allow more aggressive autovacuum (e.g., 200–2000) on I/O-capable systems; decrease to reduce impact on production load. Monitor pg_stat_progress_vacuum and table bloat to balance responsiveness and resource contention.
